LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public career stats and ranking entry for a street football player, derived from goals and successful dribbles.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

playerName.description: Public display nickname shown on the global leaderboard.

jerseyColor.description: Hex color of the player's jersey.

bootColor.description: Hex color of the player's boots.

totalScore.description: Total career points derived from goals (400 pts), ankle-breakers (250 pts), and pannas (350 pts).

goalsScored.description: Cumulative goals scored by the player.

matchesPlayed.description: Total matches completed by the player.

wins.description: Total matches won by the player.

bestMatchScore.description: Highest points earned in a single match.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the leaderboard entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the leaderboard entry was last updated.

/leaderboard/{playerId}.description: Global leaderboard rankings ordered by totalScore descending. Keyed by the authenticated user's UID.
